realm.name: USER
realm.description: A shopper: the customer surface and every /me endpoint (profile, cart, orders). Not a capability; every new sign-up gets it.

realm.name: offline_access
realm.description: ${role_offline-access}

realm.name: uma_authorization
realm.description: ${role_uma_authorization}

realm.name: default-roles-oriah
realm.description: Given to every new user (self-registered or Google-federated). Includes USER so a fresh sign-up can use the customer surface immediately.

realm.name: CATALOG_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: products, variants, categories, prices and promotions.

realm.name: INVENTORY_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: stock reads, reservations and box commitments.

realm.name: CUSTOMER_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: customer records.

realm.name: ORDER_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: order administration and status.

realm.name: PAYMENT_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: refunds and payment administration.

realm.name: PROCUREMENT_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: suppliers, purchase orders, consignments, cost lines and the opening consignment.

realm.name: FINANCE_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: expenses and the profit reports.

realm.name: SHIPPING_ADMIN
realm.description: Capability: provinces, towns, delivery options, prices and publishing them; the free-delivery threshold.

realm.name: SALES_AGENT
realm.description: Capability: record a sale or phone order; confirm a payment received, or reject a false payment claim with a reason. No cost or margin.

realm.name: FULFILMENT_AGENT
realm.description: Capability: pack, dispatch, book Yango or a courier, record the fare paid.

realm.name: COST_VIEWER
realm.description: Capability: read landed cost and margin anywhere (the allow-list behind Q29).

realm.name: STOCK_WRITE_OFF
realm.description: Capability: write off or give away stock, and take it back (Q8). Owner-only.

realm.name: BACKDATE_SALE
realm.description: Capability: record a sale paid more than 72 hours ago, with a reason (section 8.2). Owner-only.

realm.name: DELIVERY_WAIVER
realm.description: Capability: give a customer free delivery on an order, with a reason.

realm.name: OWNER
realm.description: Job role: the owner. Every capability.

realm.name: MANAGER
realm.description: Job role: a shop manager. Everything except write-offs, late-dated sales, payment administration and finance.

realm.name: SALES
realm.description: Job role: a shop or phone sales assistant. Records sales and confirms payments; sees no cost or margin.

realm.name: DISPATCH
realm.description: Job role: a packer or driver.

realm.name: BOOKKEEPER
realm.description: Job role: a part-time bookkeeper. Expenses, the profit reports, and cost and margin.
